items.title: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure local privilege escalation to root in dsinvoked broker (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw in how its dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, which lets an attacker who already has code execution as the cgi-server user escalate to root and run commands as root on the appliance. The attacker must have local access and a low-privilege login, public exploit code exists, and CISA lists the flaw as actively exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-48907: Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla remote code execution in editor profile management (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla has a flaw that lets an attacker create new editor profiles, upload PHP code, and run it on the server, and this can be done remotely without logging in. The vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, which means it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-34197: Apache ActiveMQ Broker remote code execution in Jolokia MBeans (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache ActiveMQ (including the Broker and All packages) lets an attacker who can log in with a low-privilege account run arbitrary code on the broker's Java process. They reach it remotely over the network through the web console's Jolokia endpoint, by making the broker load a remote Spring XML configuration. This bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities c...

items.title: CVE-2023-32315: Openfire authentication bypass in admin console via path traversal (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Openfire, an XMPP server from igniterealtime, has a flaw in its web-based Admin Console that lets an attacker bypass authentication and reach restricted administrator pages by using path traversal through the setup environment. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2022-0185: Linux kernel privilege escalation via heap overflow in filesystem parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A heap buffer overflow in the Linux kernel's filesystem context handling lets a local attacker escalate privileges to root, and container escape has also been reported. The attacker reaches it locally by opening a filesystem that falls back to legacy handling, and attacks using this flaw are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-1096: Google Chrome memory corruption in V8 via type confusion (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has a type confusion flaw in its V8 engine that an attacker can reach remotely, without logging in, by getting a user to open a crafted HTML page. This can corrupt memory, and the related advisory says the worst of the bundled Chromium issues could allow remote code execution; attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-0847: Linux kernel root privilege escalation in pipe buffer handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Linux kernel's pipe handling leaves a pipe buffer setting uninitialized, so a local attacker with a low-privilege account can overwrite data in read-only files through the page cache and escalate privileges to root, for example by injecting code into root processes. Attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and perform unauthorized actions within the application. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310: VMware remote code execution via path traversal in syslog server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. A directory traversal flaw in the Syslog server of VMware vCenter (also affecting VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform) lets an attacker run arbitrary code on vCenter. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-41450: Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series authentication bypass in login grants privileged access (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series devices have an improper authentication flaw that lets an attacker bypass login and gain privileged access, reachable remotely without logging in, though a user must take some action such as clicking a link. This bug is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-133469: Xen Orchestra remote authentication bypass in REST API login tokens (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Xen Orchestra (including its xo-server component) has a flaw in how its REST API handles login tokens. A remote attacker without a login can authenticate as the owner of an unexpired login token. The attacker can then retrieve reusable login token IDs for that account.

items.title: CVE-2026-133323: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated command execution in AWV component (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could let an unauthenticated attacker run arbitrary commands on the system through a blind command injection caused by insufficient parameter sanitization. It can be reached remotely over the network, without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated file upload in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A flaw in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab lets an unauthenticated attacker upload arbitrary files to the affected system because file types are not checked properly. The attack can be launched remotely over the network without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated command execution in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Mitel MiCollab's Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component does not sufficiently validate parameters, which lets an unauthenticated attacker remotely, without logging in, use pre-staged malicious content to inject XML. A successful attack could allow arbitrary commands to be run within the context of the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf remote code execution in ASP.NET CSRF token validation (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. The Idunno AntiCsrf software for ASP.NET unsafely deserializes untrusted data during its double-submit cookie and form field validation. A remote attacker can exploit this through object injection to execute code, without logging in over the network.

items.title: CVE-2026-133335
items.summary: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unauthenticated local file inclusion leading to remote code execution via controller fallback in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.7 - The main controller of the component fell back to including a controller file derived from the request without filtering the name, allowing path traversal to arbitrary local PHP files. Depending on the server setup, for example an available pearcmd.php, this could be used to execute code. The issue has been exploited in the wild. Fixed in 4.8.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-24061: GNU Inetutils remote authentication bypass in telnetd (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The telnetd service in GNU Inetutils can be tricked into logging an attacker in as root without a password, because it passes an unchecked USER value to the login program, which treats it as a command option. An attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, by connecting to a reachable telnetd server. Public exploit code exists, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-23131: Zabbix Frontend authentication bypass in SAML session storage (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix Frontend is affected when SAML single sign-on is enabled, which is not the default setup. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, change the session data, and gain admin access, as long as they know a valid Zabbix username or the guest account is enabled. It is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2022-22963: Spring Cloud Function remote code execution in SpEL routing expressions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Function's routing functionality is affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code and access local resources by sending a specially crafted SpEL routing expression, remotely and without logging in. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks using this bug are happening.

items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances running Fireware OS have a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the device, remotely and without logging in. Public exploit code exists, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-87902: WordPress remote code execution in page template resolution (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. WordPress has a flaw in how it picks a page template, which lets an attacker make the site load a chosen readable PHP file from outside the theme folders. It can be reached remotely without logging in and can lead to remote code execution when certain server and theme conditions are met, and it is listed as being exploited in attacks, with public exploit code available.

items.title: CVE-2025-2611: ICT Innovations ICTBroadcast remote code execution in session cookie handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. ICTBroadcast by ICT Innovations passes session cookie data unsafely to shell processing, so an attacker can inject shell commands into a session cookie and run them on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2022-44384: rconfig remote code execution via file upload handler (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. An arbitrary file upload flaw in rconfig lets a remote attacker with a low-privilege login upload a crafted PHP file and run arbitrary code on the server. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2025-25034: SugarCRM PHP Deserialization RCE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. SugarCRM is affected by a PHP object injection flaw that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code within the application, without logging in and without any user action. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-119618: Apache HTTP Server remote code execution in mod_http2 via race condition (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module has a race condition in its assign_headers() routine that can corrupt heap memory. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can exploit it to run arbitrary commands on the server, take control of the server process, and access or modify sensitive information. Public exploit code exists for this flaw.

items.title: CVE-2019-17382: Zabbix authentication bypass in dashboard page (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix has a flaw that lets a remote attacker bypass the login page without logging in, then create dashboards, reports, screens, or maps. Other users and administrators can then access these items. Public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2015-10141: Xdebug unauthenticated command injection in remote debugger (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Xdebug, a PHP debugging extension, has an unauthenticated command injection flaw in its remote debugger, which listens on port 9000 when remote debugging is enabled. A remote attacker without a login can send a crafted eval command to run arbitrary PHP code, including system commands, gaining full control of the host with the web server user's privileges, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: blankspace

Blank Space can create arbitrary files on a remote host that is using unconstrained delegation if it isn't patched for CVE-2021-43893. File creation is done using the privileges of the remote user, so code execution is a bit speculative but defintely a possibility. items.title: CVE-2026-103406: Juniper Session Smart Conductor unauthenticated command execution in AutomatedProvisioner (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor is affected, specifically its AutomatedProvisioner component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this flaw to run arbitrary commands with root privileges on the system.

items.title: CVE-2017-9841: PHPUnit remote code execution in eval-stdin.php script (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHPUnit, a widely used testing framework for PHP, is affected by this vulnerability. An attacker can remotely run arbitrary PHP code on a server if its vendor folder is publicly accessible, potentially giving them full control of the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2024-36401: GeoServer remote code execution in property name evaluation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GeoServer, the open source server for sharing and editing geospatial data, has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending crafted request parameters, remotely and without logging in. It affects default installations through web requests such as WFS, WMS and WPS calls, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2017-12615: Apache Tomcat remote code execution via file upload in default servlet (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, a widely used web server for Java applications, is affected when run on Windows with HTTP PUT requests enabled. An attacker could upload a malicious JSP file through a specially crafted request, allowing the attacker's code to run on the server.

items.title: CVE-2012-1823: PHP remote code execution in the CGI binary (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The PHP interpreter when run as a CGI program (php-cgi) is affected, along with any web server setup that uses it to handle requests. An attacker who sends a specially crafted request with command-line options in the query string could run arbitrary code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2014-6271: Remote code execution in environment variable parsing (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GNU Bash, the common Linux and Unix command shell, runs extra commands hidden after a function definition in an environment variable's value. A remote attacker can use this to run shell commands and take over a system, without logging in, whenever a service such as an SSH, web server CGI or DHCP client setup passes attacker-controlled environment variables to Bash. This flaw is listed as exploi...

items.title: CVE-2024-27198: JetBrains TeamCity auth bypass in server login allows admin actions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. JetBrains TeamCity has an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker perform administrator actions on the server. It can be exploited remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2018-14847: Unauthenticated file read in WinBox interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. MikroTik RouterOS has a directory traversal flaw in its WinBox interface that lets an attacker connect to the Winbox port remotely, without logging in, and read the system user database file, which exposes router credentials including plain text passwords. CISA lists this bug as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24086: Adobe Magento Commerce remote code execution in checkout input validation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Adobe Commerce (Magento Commerce) has an input validation flaw in its checkout process that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2023-43208: Unauthenticated code execution via command injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect has a flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server remotely, without logging in, which could be used to gain initial access or to compromise sensitive healthcare data. On Windows the code typically runs with the highest system privileges, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-20699: Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware unauthenticated remote code execution in HTTP server (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware, used on RV160, RV260, RV340 and RV345 routers, has vulnerabilities that let a remote attacker run arbitrary code with root privileges on the router by sending crafted HTTP requests, without logging in. Attacks using these flaws are happening, and exploitation is most relevant for RV340 and RV345 routers acting as an SSL VPN gateway.

items.title: CVE-2022-22954: VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager remote code execution via server-side template injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager have a server-side template injection flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22965: Spring remote code execution via data binding (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Framework applications using Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux on JDK 9 or later can be taken over through data binding, letting an attacker run code on the application server remotely without logging in. The known exploit needs a non-default setup, with the app deployed as a WAR on Tomcat rather than as a Spring Boot executable jar, and attacks are happening, since the bug is listed in CISA'...

items.title: CVE-2022-24112: Apache APISIX auth bypass in batch-requests plugin via X-REAL-IP (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache APISIX, through its batch-requests plugin, lets an attacker overwrite the client IP header and bypass the Admin API IP restriction, which in a default setup with the default API key leads to remote code execution; otherwise the data panel IP restriction can still be bypassed. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24990: Unauthenticated remote code execution in web interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. TerraMaster NAS devices are affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code on the device, such as uploading a PHP webshell, by abusing PHP object instantiation. It can be reached remotely without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21882: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32k (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Win32k component of Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server (including Windows Server 2019 and 2022) lets an attacker gain higher privileges than they should have. The attacker must already be able to run code on the machine with a low-privilege account, and this flaw is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21999: Microsoft privilege escalation in print spooler service (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Windows Print Spooler service on several Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server releases lets an attacker raise their privileges to take much greater control of the system. The attacker must already have a low-privileged account on the machine, and no action from another user is needed. This bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-0995: Linux kernel privilege escalation via watch_queue out-of-bounds write (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's watch_queue event notification subsystem has an out-of-bounds memory write flaw that can overwrite kernel state, letting an attacker gain privileged access or crash the system. It is reached locally by someone who already has a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134401: Google Chrome remote code execution in Variations (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has an input validation flaw in its Variations component. A remote attacker could use a specially crafted HTML page to potentially run arbitrary code outside the browser sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-132660: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager remote code execution via SECURITY DEFINER search path (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager has several privileged database functions that don't use a safe search path, so a user who can connect to its backend database can plant objects that the functions use in their place. Over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, an attacker can use this to run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-132658: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager privilege escalation via agent role file access (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager gives its agent role file read and write access on the PEM server, so an attacker who controls any monitored host can read and write files on the server as the postgres operating system user. This is reachable over the network by someone with high-privilege login access, and it exposes the certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certif...

items.summary: Am 23. November 2026 listete die Ransomware-Gruppe Safepay einen Hersteller von Förderanlagen aus Nordrhein-Westfalen auf ihrer Leak-Seite. Die Angreifer machten keine Angaben zur Art oder Menge der angeblich exfiltrierten Daten. Im Umfeld des Angriffs wurden Infostealer-Aktivitäten festgestellt, die fünf Mitarbeiter betrafen. » Details

items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM800A has an input validation flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the device. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2023-25914: Danfoss AK-SM800A authenticated path traversal in XML interface (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM800A has a path traversal flaw in its XML interface that lets an attacker with a low-privilege login read system files on the underlying server, which could lead to a full system compromise. It can be reached remotely over the network with no user interaction, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-132224: Optimizely Web Experimentation attacker code injection in account signup flow (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Optimizely Web Experimentation mishandles its account signup flow, which lets an attacker place their own code in the projectJS (Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets. An attacker can exploit this remotely over the network with a low-privilege account, and no action from a user is needed.

items.title: CVE-2026-16666 | mcu-tools MCUboot up to 1.0.0 Image Swap loader.c boot_swap_image swap_size out-of-bounds
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in mcu-tools MCUboot up to 1.0.0 . It has been classified as problematic . This affects the function boot_swap_image of the file boot/bootutil/src/loader.c of the component Image Swap . Performing a manipulation of the argument swap_size results in out-of-bounds read. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-16666 . The attack is only possible with local access. There is not any exploit available.

items.title: ZDI-26-1069: (0Day) BusyBox ftpd Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Read and Write Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create or delete arbitrary files or disclose sensitive information on affected installations of BusyBox. items.title: CVE-2026-128838
items.summary: The ADDRESSYA WordPress plugin through 3.1.1 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks when saving its service credentials, and does not escape them when outputting them in an admin page, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-124284
items.summary: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation. Under specific conditions, successful exploitation may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the system with the privileges of an affected user. Successful exploitation requires a specific combination of conditions to be met, which reduces the likelihood of a successful attack.

items.title: CVE-2026-136455
items.summary: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

items.title: CVE-2026-136241
items.summary: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

items.title: CVE-2026-136178
items.summary: Endurain before 0.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/strava/link endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify Strava integrations using only a victim's strava_state value. Attackers can submit a leaked state with their own OAuth code to link an attacker-controlled Strava account, or an invalid code to remove the victim's integration.

items.title: CVE-2026-136165
items.summary: Fider before 0.40.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to sign in as existing users by linking OAuth identities through unverified email matches. Attackers can use a Google account carrying an unverified copy of a victim's email, including a tenant administrator's, to bind their identity via the OAuthToken handler and obtain persistent session access.

items.title: CVE-2026-56164: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 unauthenticated privilege escalation in server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the 2016 Enterprise, 2019, and Subscription Edition releases) is missing an authentication check on a critical function, which lets an attacker gain higher privileges. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21971: Microsoft Windows code execution in WinRT (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in Microsoft's Windows Runtime, which affects several Windows 10 and Windows Server releases, lets an attacker run code of their choosing on the affected system. The attacker needs local access but no login, and a user must take some action, such as opening something, to trigger it. Public exploit code exists and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22947: Spring Cloud Gateway remote code injection in actuator endpoint (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Gateway is vulnerable to code injection that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending a crafted request, without logging in. This only works with a non-default setup in which the Gateway Actuator endpoint is enabled, exposed and unsecured, and public exploit code exists (including a Metasploit module) and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti Connect Secure authenticated remote file upload via predictable filenames (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw that lets an attacker who is logged in with a low-privilege account upload files with content they control to a known location on the device's disk, reaching it remotely over the network with no user interaction needed. It can be chained with other vulnerabilities, public exploit code is available, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2015-3306: ProFTPD access control bypass in mod_copy (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The mod_copy module in ProFTPD, an FTP server (including the Debian proftpd-dfsg package), lets an attacker copy files around on the server and possibly run arbitrary code. The attacker can do this remotely without logging in by using the "site cpfr" and "site cpto" commands. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-20320: Cisco BroadWorks remote file read via XXE in OCI XML parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco BroadWorks has a flaw in how its OCI-P service handles XML, letting an attacker read sensitive files, including configuration information, from the system with the privileges of the BroadWorks user. It can be exploited remotely without logging in by sending a crafted XML message, public exploit code is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-12268: Authenticated PowerShell Injection leads to RCE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6201 are vulnerable to PowerShell command injection in Windows DNS SPF/TXT record push leading to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2023-35854: Authentication bypass in domain controller sessions (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus has an authentication bypass that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, steal the domain controller session token, spoof identities, and gain domain controller administrator privileges. The vendor says it has found no evidence of a security vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2023-6634: ThimPress LearnPress remote code execution via get_content function (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The LearnPress WordPress LMS plugin, from thimpress, has a command injection flaw in its get_content function. Remotely and without logging in, an attacker can call any public function with a single parameter, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2022-25330: Trend Micro remote code execution in information server (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Trend Micro ServerProtect for Storage, for Microsoft Windows / Novell NetWare, for EMC Celerra, and for Network Appliance Filers contain integer overflow conditions that a remote attacker can reach over the network without logging in or any user action. Exploiting them could crash the process or allow remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2023-32530: Trend Micro Apex Central authenticated SQL injection in on-premise modules (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Trend Micro Apex Central (on-premise) has vulnerable modules that let an attacker who already has a login run SQL injection, which can lead to remote code execution. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network, but must first obtain valid credentials on the system.

items.title: CVE-2022-0948: Order Listener for WooCommerce unauthenticated SQL injection in REST route (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Order Listener for WooCommerce plugin, which plays sounds on new orders, is affected before version 3.2.2. An attacker can remotely, without logging in, send crafted input through a REST route to run SQL commands against the site's database.

items.title: CVE-2023-53963: Unauthenticated OS command injection in login.php (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. SOUND4 IMPACT, FIRST, PULSE, and Eco products, along with the BigVoice4, BigVoice2, and Stream products and Kantar Media's WM2, contain an unauthenticated OS command injection flaw. Remote attackers without logging in can run arbitrary shell commands with web server privileges by sending commands in the 'password' POST parameter of login.php and index.php.

items.title: CVE-2026-124002: Copeland XWEB EVO pre-auth command injection via username field (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Copeland's XWEB EVO is affected by a flaw that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, run arbitrary operating system commands by injecting shell characters into the username field before the password check. Because the attacker can combine this with a root-level interpreter on the device, they could gain full control of the system.

items.title: CVE-2022-34753: Schneider SpaceLogic C-Bus Home Controller remote root access via OS command injection in controller (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Schneider Electric's SpaceLogic C-Bus Home Controller has an OS command injection flaw that lets an attacker with a low-privilege login reach it over the network and potentially gain remote root access. Public exploit code for this issue is available.

items.title: CVE-2022-0778: Infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt() reachable when parsing certificates (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Software that parses certificates, including OpenSSL and the mariadb, mysql-client, and node packages, contains an infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt(). A remote attacker can trigger it without logging in, causing a denial of service by sending a crafted certificate, which is parsed before its signature is checked. Public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2011-10019: Spreecommerce remote code execution in search parameter (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.60.2 contains a remote command execution vulnerability in its search functionality. The application fails to properly sanitize input passed via the search[send][] parameter, which is dynamically invoked using Ruby’s send method. This allows attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server without authentication.

items.title: CVE-2011-10026: Spreecommerce remote code execution in API search parameter (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.50.x contain a remote command execution vulnerability in the API's search functionality. Improper input sanitation allows attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands via the search[instance_eval] parameter, which is dynamically invoked using Ruby’s send method. This flaw enables unauthenticated attackers to execute commands on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-133971
items.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in the web management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized administrative access to the affected system, impacting the confidentiality and integrity of AirWave.

items.title: CVE-2026-69695
items.summary: Handesk through 1.5 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Attachment::storeAttachmentFromRequest() that allows authenticated agents to upload files with arbitrary extensions by attaching them to ticket comments without extension, MIME type, or size validation. Attackers can upload a PHP file via POST /tickets/{ticket}/comments, which is stored under storage/app/public/attachments and served from /storage/attachments/, to achieve remote code execution as the web server user or serve malicious HTML/SVG content from the application origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-69696
items.summary: Handesk through 1.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the POST /webhook/bitbucket route, which is excluded from CSRF verification and processed by WebhookController::store() without validating any secret, signature, or request source before writing to the database. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted Bitbucket issue payloads referencing a linked roadmap Idea or ticket to alter the Idea's status or inject attacker-controlled notes attributed to the first administrator account.

items.title: CVE-2026-131819
items.summary: ChargePoint Home Flex Debug Interface With Improper Access Control Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to bypass authentication on affected ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the serial debug interface. The issue results from the lack of access control prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28997.

items.title: CVE-2026-131818

The issue results from the setuid flag being set. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29090.

items.title: CVE-2026-123879
items.summary: In authd before 0.7.2, an improper access control vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to complete a first-time SSH login with another account's UID and incorrect primary GID, and to read or modify files owned by that account. This allows an attacker to access another account's data, potentially enabling account takeover or privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-102987
items.summary: Plane is an open-source project management tool. In versions prior to 1.4.0, the v2 asset static endpoint allows unauthenticated requests and returns presigned S3 URLs for an asset with access-signed parameters. Any user who knows an asset UUID can retrieve the signed URL without an account, providing access to that asset. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

Unauthenticated attackers can choose the scheme, host and port of the request to make the server connect to internal hosts an…

items.title: CVE-2026-137086
items.summary: Teracom TCW122B-CM firmware before 4.07 contains a predictable session cookie vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions by guessing tick-counter-derived cookies. Attackers can predict or brute-force the 32-bit cookie from device uptime and login timing to control relays, settings, and administrator credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-137066
items.summary: Loginizer before 2.1.4 contains a brute-force lockout bypass vulnerability in loginizer_login_failed() that allows unauthenticated attackers to avoid failed-attempt recording via non-ASCII URL bytes. Attackers can append invalid UTF-8 or 4-byte sequences to wp-login.php or xmlrpc.php request URLs, causing the log INSERT to fail and enabling unlimited password guessing without lockout or email notification.

items.title: CVE-2026-137084
items.summary: NodeBB 4.12.0 before 4.16.4 contains an execution after redirect vulnerability in the Intents.create controller that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger ActivityPub note ingestion. Attackers can send GET requests to /intents/create with a remote note URI in the toPid parameter to inject federated content as local topics and posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137064
items.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Bandwidth SMS webhook endpoint POST /webhooks/sms/:phone_number that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit forged SMS events. Attackers who know an inbox phone number can set the 'to' field to inject inbound messages with forged sender numbers or forge delivery status updates.

items.title: CVE-2026-137059
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.16.0 before 3.20.256 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in StripeWebhookGuard that validates webhooks against a self-generated signature instead of the Stripe-Signature header. Unauthenticated attackers can post forged Stripe events to the POST /api/organization/payment/webhooks route to activate subscriptions, generate licenses, change plans or seats, and add AI credits without payment.

items.title: CVE-2026-137058
items.summary: Cron-parser through 5.10.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137057
items.summary: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the process and exhaust memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-81418
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single crafted EIGRP Update of roughly 36 bytes over unauthenticated multicast, causing unbounded table growth that exhausts the memory of the Nmap process when broadcast-eigrp-discovery.nse is running.

items.title: CVE-2026-77230
items.summary: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combi…

items.title: CVE-2026-135228
items.summary: A vulnerability in the MongoDB integration package for the Laravel framework allows an unauthorized user to bypass mass assignment attribute protections. When an application uses attribute deny-lists to guard sensitive model fields, specially crafted request payloads containing database operator keys can circumvent these protections. An unauthorized user with network access to an affected application endpoint can modify guarded attributes, potentially leading to privilege escalation within the application

items.title: CVE-2026-81419
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero length. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single spoofed, unauthenticated OSPF LS Update packet, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process as soon as broadcast-ospf2-discover.nse captures it.

items.title: CVE-2026-81336
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute quick actions through Service Desk emails due to improper input sanitization.

items.title: CVE-2026-132102
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 14.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to cause denial of service due to unconstrained backtracking in regular expression evaluation.

Because the route is public and uses the attacker-controlled installation.id to locate integrations, an unauthenticated remote attacker who knows or guesses an installation identifier can forge installation del…

items.title: CVE-2026-132888
items.summary: A flaw was found in librelp. When configured to use Transport Layer Security (TLS) with certificate validation and the GnuTLS driver, the library fails to verify the peer certificate chain. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this issue by presenting an invalid or self-signed certificate, allowing them to bypass authentication and act as a trusted log source or collector.

items.title: CVE-2026-136916
items.summary: HortusFox (hortusfox-web) through 6.4 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in UserModel::restorePassword that builds reset links from the client-controlled Host header. Unauthenticated attackers can request a reset with a forged Host header to capture the victim's reset token and take over accounts including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-136915
items.summary: HortusFox through 6.4 contains an information exposure vulnerability in BackupModule::start that allows unauthenticated attackers to download workspace backups stored in the public/backup directory. Attackers can enumerate one-second-precision creation timestamps used as filenames to retrieve archives containing locations, plants, gallery, tasks, inventory and calendar data.

items.title: CVE-2026-136912
items.summary: Paid Memberships Pro before 3.8.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted post excerpts because restriction is reapplied only through the_excerpt filter. Attackers can request RSS or Atom feeds, oEmbed URLs, or pages rendering the Post Excerpt block to read opening text or manual excerpts of member-only posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-135227
items.summary: An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.

items.title: CVE-2026-135226
items.summary: A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serialized document is framed. Content placed in one value may be read back as additional or replacement document fields. An unauthenticated party supplying input to an application that parses untrusted Extended JSON and stores the result may cause unintended modification of stored data.

items.title: CVE-2026-135898
items.summary: An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted BSON data to the decoder to cause the application process to terminate. In some configurations, nearby process memory may be included in error messages, which may result in limited unintended disclosure of data.

items.title: CVE-2026-135146
items.summary: An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that operates the network endpoint a client connects to, and that holds a revoked but still-dated certificate trusted by that client, to have the connection accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of application credentials and other session data, and in the client treating responses from that endpoint as genuine.

items.title: CVE-2026-136267
items.summary: Improper sanitization of mixed data and markup elements when processing content in Kiro Web before 2026-10-30, in combination with agents running specific models such as DeepSeek v3.2, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, MiniMax M2.5, or Qwen3-coder-next, may allow a remote unauthenticated actor to execute arbitrary commands in a subscriber's hosted development environment via crafted content being repeated back to the user by the agent. AWS has addressed this issue. No customer action is required.

items.title: CVE-2026-135224
items.summary: The MongoDB C Driver does not confirm that the party signing a supplied certificate revocation status response is authorized to answer for the certificate being checked. An unauthenticated party that operates the TLS endpoint a client connects to can therefore have a withdrawn certificate accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of the application's database traffic and in the loss of the revocation decision.

items.title: CVE-2026-135134
items.summary: A NULL pointer dereference and invalid memory release in the server discovery component of the MongoDB C Driver may allow an unauthenticated party that controls a server endpoint, or that can alter unencrypted network traffic, to cause a client application to terminate by sending a crafted discovery response.

items.title: CVE-2026-135150
items.summary: In Eclipse Ditto versions 1.1.0 to 3.9.9, the nginx reverse proxy configurations shipped with Ditto (Helm chart, Docker Compose, Kubernetes and OpenShift deployment files) forward a client-supplied `x-ditto-pre-authenticated` header to the Ditto gateway on locations that do not apply nginx authentication, such as `/api/2/connections`. nginx selects the location based on the normalized request URI but forwards the raw URI, while the gateway does not treat an encoded slash (`%2f`) as a path separator. A crafted request path is therefore routed by nginx through such an unauthenticated location an…

items.title: CVE-2026-80273
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and privilege escalation, resulting in complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-114346
items.summary: The phsuperpack module for PrestaShop is vulnerable to a missing authorization check. The controller at /module/phsuperpack/pack can be accessed without login, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify the module's data and create, edit, or delete products, including the complete deletion of a product with its translations, shop associations, stock, and images. This issue was fixed in version 3.0.26.

items.title: CVE-2026-136706
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in the DIGIT Platform due to improper neutralization of user supplied input while constructing SQL queries and execution in the affected User and Access Control Service components. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted input through the affected API endpoint to the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially resulting in unauthorized disclosure, modification or deletion of database information on the targeted system.

items.title: CVE-2026-129968
items.summary: LiteSpeed Cache Plugin for Prestashop does not verify authenticity of "pd" parameter and uses it to render a template without checking that it is a real .tpl file. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted requests to a store that cause the server to process attacker-suplied content, potentially giving the attacker full control of the store and access to customer and payment data. This issue was fixed in version 1.6.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-128857
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the source URL, destination path or file type when an unauthenticated AJAX action fetches a file and writes it to a web-accessible directory, allowing unauthenticated users to upload executable PHP files and achieve remote code execution, as well as read arbitrary local files.

items.title: CVE-2026-128854
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate URLs taken from the request before fetching them server-side and returning the response, allowing unauthenticated users to make the server request internal resources and read the responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115280
items.summary: The Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 does not perform authorisation checks when rendering its front-end print document for a reserved order identifier, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the configured store contact details (including the site administrator's email address) and to create Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 files in arbitrary existing, writable directories outside the Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0's own folder.

items.title: CVE-2026-134630
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Perl Modules (cpan) module, which downloads CPAN indexes and module archives over plaintext HTTP without checksum or signature verification. On-path network attackers can answer the outbound fetch while an administrator installs a CPAN module, supplying a malicious Makefile.PL that cpan/download.cgi runs as root before confirmation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134643
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in password_change.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to change passwords for accounts with empty stored hashes. When passwd_mode is 2, attackers can POST user, old, new1 and new2 with any old value to set a known password and gain access.

items.title: CVE-2026-136631
items.summary: Mastodon 4.7.4 and 4.8.0-alpha.3 before 5.0.0-beta.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in authenticate_with_sign_in_token that allows authenticated local users to rebind pending login attempts to other accounts. Attackers can submit sign_in_token_resend with a victim's user[email] parameter, then guess the unthrottled 6-character token to sign in as inactive accounts lacking two-factor authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-136626
items.summary: SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SrsRtcpCommon::decode and SrsRtcpTWCC::decode that lets remote WebRTC peers write past the fixed 1500-byte payload_ array. Unauthenticated attackers opening a WHIP or WHEP session can send oversized BYE, APP, unknown-type or TWCC RTCP packets to overwrite up to 64 KB of heap memory, crashing the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-134648
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a header directive injection vulnerability in sendmail/autoreply.pl that allows unauthenticated mail senders to inject autoreply directives by placing them in inbound subject, from, date, or body fields. Attackers can inject Reply-Tracking to delete files at chosen paths, Autoreply-File to exfiltrate files readable by the delivery user, or arbitrary reply headers including To.

items.title: CVE-2026-134644
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check_playtime_limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134642
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134447
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in postfix/view_mailq.cgi and sendmail/view_mailq.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via unsanitized MIME attachment filenames. Attackers can send a message with a crafted Content-Disposition or Content-Type filename that remains queued, executing script in the Webmin session of users viewing it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134340

Attackers on the same broadcast domain can answer discovery scans with HTML or JavaScript stored by find_servers() and rendered unescaped by edit_serv.cgi, executing in Webmin user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134336

Attackers can repeatedly submit crafted usernames until blocked, executing script in administrator sessions viewing edit_blocked.cgi in Webmin or Usermin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134328

items.title: CVE-2026-134304

Unauthenticated attackers can inject script into error_log via malformed requests or denied paths, executing in a Webmin user's session when Apache fails to restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-136630

items.title: CVE-2026-136627
